snippet.title: Smile Town // Game Intro
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4450030/Smile_Town

Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

Developed by
HAGUKI
